welcome.point2: Withdraw to telebirr, CBE Birr or your bank

coinPolicy.title: How {{brand}} works
coinPolicy.p1: Businesses pay to show you their ads and offers. We keep part of that payment to run the platform and pass the rest to you as coins.
coinPolicy.p2: Every reward is fixed and shown before you start. There are no chance-based prizes, no lotteries and no games.
coinPolicy.p3: Coins convert at a fixed rate ({{rate}}) and can be withdrawn once you reach the minimum. Your first withdrawal and large amounts are reviewed by a person.
coinPolicy.p4: We only pay rewards for genuine views. Automated or repeated views are rejected and can lead to a suspended account.
